The Parents Sports Meet – “Synergy 2.0” was organized by Don Bosco English Medium School, Shirva, on 8th November 2025 at the school ground.

The event aimed to foster a stronger sense of community and connection among parents, students, and the school management. It also sought to promote fitness, teamwork, and healthy competition within the parent community.

The meet commenced with a formal inauguration ceremony, graced by Mr. Ganesh Nayak, Businessman, Shirva, as the Chief Guest, along with Very Rev. Dr. Leslie Clifford D’Souza, Correspondent, Don Bosco & St. Mary’s Institutions; Mrs. Anitha Priya D’Souza, President of the Parent-Teacher Association; and Rev. Fr. Rolwyn Joy Aranha, Principal of the school.

In his address, Mr. Ganesh Nayak encouraged parents to participate actively in the sports meet to inspire their children to engage enthusiastically in school activities. He emphasized that winning or losing is secondary—the true spirit lies in participation and togetherness. By seeing their parents as role models, children too will learn the value of effort and sportsmanship.

In his presidential address, Very Rev. Dr. Leslie Clifford D’Souza expressed his gratitude to the parents for their overwhelming participation and enthusiasm. He highlighted that such initiatives strengthen the bond between parents and teachers, fostering better collaboration and understanding.

The sports meet featured a variety of exciting events, thoughtfully categorized by age groups to encourage inclusive participation. With the dedicated efforts of the Principal, Vice Principal, teaching and non-teaching staff, and student volunteers, the event turned out to be a grand success.

The day proved to be a memorable celebration of unity and joy, reinforcing the strong partnership between parents and the school, and setting a high benchmark for future community-building initiatives.
The event was compered by Ms. Sushmitha Prabhu, with a warm welcome delivered by Mrs. Cynthia Pereira, and words of appreciation and gratitude expressed by Sr. Diana Lobo.

title: Patron’s Day Celebration
excerpt: Don Bosco School celebrated its Patron’s Day with great joy and devotion on the feast day of St. John Bosco. The programme was organized in the school auditorium in a solemn and...
paragraphs: Don Bosco School celebrated its Patron’s Day with great joy and devotion on the feast day of St. John Bosco. The programme was organized in the school auditorium in a solemn and festive atmosphere.

Fr. Royal Vijay Fernandes graced the occasion as the Chief Guest, while the School Correspondent Very. Rev.  Dr. Lessely Clifford D’Souza presided over the programme as the President. The celebration began with a prayer invoking God’s blessings, followed by a warm welcome to the dignitaries.

In his presidential address, the School Correspondent highlighted the significance of Patron’s Day and emphasized the relevance of St. Don Bosco’s teachings in today’s world. The Chief Guest, Fr. Royal, in his inspiring speech, called upon the students to uphold the nine values of St. Don Bosco, such fear of God, do not waste time, focus, eat moderately, play, have good companionship, pay attention to school crricullum perseverance, prayer and service to others in their daily lives.

The cultural programme was the highlight of the celebration. Students presented songs, dances, and skit beautifully depicting the life, mission, and values of St. Don Bosco, which left a deep impression on the audience. The performances reflected the students’ talents and their understanding of the importance of the day.

The programme concluded with a vote of thanks, expressing gratitude to the dignitaries, teachers, and students for making the celebration meaningful and memorable. The Patron’s Day celebration truly inspired everyone to follow the noble path shown by St. John Bosco.
